biology: The host is recorded as Cunninghamia lanceolata.
soldier: The head is orange-yellow, the mandibles yellowish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index about 0.58, the sides parallel and slightly expanded in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is raised. The labrum is long-lingulate with a bluntly rounded apex, the apical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are robust with strongly curved apices, about 0.56 times the head capsule length and 0.97 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior quarter, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and slightly concave at the middle, the sides roughly parallel, the waist constriction index 0.37. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, 1.77 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin deeply concave and that of the posterior margin shallowly concave, with about thirty hairs in the middle region. The femoral segments of the legs are slightly curved, flat and broad, their width equal to 2.5 times the width of the tibia.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.
